name: What is involved in a remote luxury property search?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a remote luxury property search?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remote luxury property search involves using technology and expert local representation to find and evaluate high-end real estate without needing to be physically present. This typically includes virtual tours, detailed property videos, drone footage for aerial perspectives, and comprehensive digital documentation review. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution leverages advanced virtual tools and local market expertise in areas like Miami-Dade and Broward Counties to facilitate a seamless remote experience, ensuring you have a complete understanding of the property and its surroundings.
acceptedAnswer.description: A remote luxury property search uses technology and local experts to find high-end real estate without physical presence, involving virtual tours and digital documentation.
